title: Student residence work hours
document_excerpt: Third-country students with a study residence permit in Hungary may work during the study period under the published OIF factsheet rules. The public English page states a weekly hour limit during studies and notes separate holiday-period rules where applicable.
reference_summary:
1. OIF publishes student residence rules for third-country nationals in Hungary.
2. Study-permit holders may work during the study period under those rules.
3. The English factsheet states a weekly work-hour limit while studying.
4. Holiday-period work rules can differ from the study-period limit.
5. Always confirm the cited OIF page before relying on an hour figure.

title: Study permit extension steps
document_excerpt: Extension of a residence permit for studies is submitted on Enter Hungary at least thirty days before expiry. Applicants upload required documents and later give biometrics at the regional client service within the stated deadline.
reference_summary:
1. Extend a study residence permit on Enter Hungary.
2. File at least 30 days before the current permit expires.
3. Upload the required documents in the online case.
4. Give biometrics at the regional client service after filing.
5. Missing the biometrics visit can delete the application.

title: Permit length for studies
document_excerpt: A residence permit for the purpose of studies is issued for at least one year and at most three years, adjusted to shorter programmes, and cannot outlast the travel document.
reference_summary:
1. Study residence permits have a minimum length of one year.
2. The maximum length is three years in the general case.
3. Shorter programmes can receive a permit matched to programme length.
4. Validity cannot exceed the applicant travel document.
5. Institutions should follow the OIF higher-education factsheet.
